# Reviewed title-mapping evidence

reviewed-2026-10-07.json records independent expected title/author, official award identity, edition scope, translation credits and primary evidence URLs reviewed on 7 October 2026. It paraphrases catalog/title/copyright facts rather than reproducing copyrighted text. Official award rows come from the existing four source HTML fixture sets. Tests run offline through production lookups and isolated caches. See awards/data/english_title_mapping_review_2026-10-07.md for exclusions.
